netz.knoten.m_breitband.text: Fibre and mobile coverage down to the village.

netz.knoten.energieimporte.text: Share of imported energy, above all gas and oil.

netz.knoten.m_kernkraft.name: Nuclear power
netz.knoten.m_kernkraft.text: More reactors alongside the first power plant.

netz.knoten.m_gasfoerderung.text: Production from fields in the Black Sea.
netz.knoten.m_umweltauflagen.name: Environmental standards
netz.knoten.m_umweltauflagen.text: Limits for industry, power plants and transport.
netz.knoten.m_co2_preis.name: Carbon price
netz.knoten.m_co2_preis.text: A price on emissions, important for trade with the EU.
netz.knoten.m_netzausbau.name: Grid expansion
netz.knoten.p_stromausfaelle.text: The grid cannot carry the load.
netz.knoten.p_luftverschmutzung.name: Air pollution
netz.knoten.gasabhaengigkeit.name: Gas dependence by supplier
netz.knoten.gasabhaengigkeit.text: How concentrated gas imports are: Russia ~36 % (contract expires end of 2026), LNG pool ~35–40 %, Azerbaijan ~20 %, Iran effectively zero, domestic ~6 %.
netz.knoten.sakarya_gas.name: Production from the Sakarya field
netz.knoten.sakarya_gas.text: Own gas from the Black Sea: 9.5 million m³ a day in phase 1; the target range for 2028 is 20–40 million m³.
netz.knoten.strommix.name: Renewable share of the power mix
netz.knoten.strommix.text: Share of hydro, wind, solar and geothermal in power generation, recently ~43–45 %.
netz.knoten.energieversorgung.name: Security of energy supply
netz.knoten.energieversorgung.text: Whether gas and power arrive safely in winter too: contracts, storage (6.3 bn m³), own production. Winter 2026/27 is considered critical.
netz.knoten.energie_importrechnung.name: Energy import bill
netz.knoten.energie_importrechnung.text: What the country pays abroad each year for oil, gas and coal; ~58–62 bn dollars are projected for 2026, figures appear with a two-month lag.
netz.knoten.energie_subventionslast.name: Energy subsidy burden
netz.knoten.energie_subventionslast.text: What the price caps cost the budget: ~950 bn lira at BOTAŞ plus ~600 bn lira of forgone fuel compensation (Eşel-Mobil), projected for 2026.
netz.knoten.strompreis.name: Wholesale electricity price
netz.knoten.strompreis.text: Exchange price for electricity (PTF), recently ~60 dollars per megawatt hour with a cap of 4,500 lira.
netz.knoten.p_energiemangel.name: Energy shortage
netz.knoten.p_energiemangel.text: Gas and power run short; rationing hits industry and power plants first, never households (BOTAŞ priority rules).
netz.knoten.m_lng_vertraege.name: Long-term LNG contracts
netz.knoten.m_lng_vertraege.text: Additional long-term contracts for two to four bn m³ of liquefied gas a year; LNG costs 30–50 % more than pipeline gas.
netz.knoten.m_regas_ausbau.name: FSRU and regasification expansion
netz.knoten.m_regas_ausbau.text: More floating terminals and landing capacity for LNG (0.5–1.5 bn dollars); the reserve for cold weeks.
netz.knoten.m_gasspeicher.name: Gas storage expansion
netz.knoten.m_gasspeicher.text: Expand storage towards 14.4 bn m³ (benchmark Tuz Gölü: 2.7 bn dollars for 4.2 bn m³), the cushion for winter.
netz.knoten.m_yeka_serie.name: YEKA tender series
netz.knoten.m_yeka_serie.text: Auction at least two gigawatts of wind and solar a year; with capped purchase prices the state even earns money through the contribution mechanism.
netz.knoten.m_sakarya_phase3.name: Sakarya phase 3 (second FPU)
netz.knoten.m_sakarya_phase3.text: A second floating production unit lifts own output towards 40 million m³ a day; single-digit billions of dollars, effective from 2028 at the earliest.
netz.knoten.m_akkuyu_ppa.name: Renegotiate the Akkuyu contract
netz.knoten.m_akkuyu_ppa.text: Renegotiate the purchase agreement with Rosatom (12.35 US cents per kWh); the gap to the market price costs roughly one bn dollars a year, and the dispute strains ties with Moscow.
netz.knoten.m_heimische_kohle.name: Domestic coal (Afşin-Elbistan)
netz.knoten.m_heimische_kohle.text: New units at the domestic coal basin (+688 MW) replace imported coal, at the expense of climate, air and the local neighbours.
netz.knoten.m_energieeffizienz.name: Efficiency, heat pumps, e-mobility
netz.knoten.m_energieeffizienz.text: Programmes against waste: one million electric cars save ~0.9 bn dollars of imports a year, ten per cent of households with heat pumps another ~1 bn.
netz.knoten.m_preiswahrheit.name: Cost-reflective energy prices
netz.knoten.m_preiswahrheit.text: Cut subsidies and introduce tiered tariffs: saves up to ~600 bn lira a year but pushes prices up in the short term; the political price of honesty.
netz.knoten.m_gashub.name: Gas hub and transit expansion
netz.knoten.m_gashub.text: TurkStream line 2 and TANAP expansion: transit fees and geopolitical weight, but closer ties to Russian gas.
netz.knoten.wasserversorgung.name: Water supply
netz.knoten.wasserversorgung.text: Whether cities and fields have enough clean water.
netz.knoten.duerre.name: Drought
netz.knoten.duerre.text: Lack of rainfall and falling groundwater levels.
netz.knoten.ernte.name: Harvests
netz.knoten.ernte.text: Yields of grain, fruit, vegetables and cotton.
netz.knoten.lebensmittelpreise.name: Food prices
netz.knoten.lebensmittelpreise.text: Prices of bread, vegetables, meat and milk.
netz.knoten.landwirtschaft_einkommen.tex: What farmers have left after costs.
netz.knoten.landflucht.name: Rural exodus
netz.knoten.landflucht.text: How many people leave villages and small towns.
netz.knoten.m_agrarsubventionen.name: Farm subsidies
netz.knoten.m_agrarsubventionen.text: Payments per area and product, subsidies for diesel and fertiliser.
netz.knoten.m_bewaesserung.name: Modern irrigation
netz.knoten.m_bewaesserung.text: Drip irrigation instead of flooding the fields.
netz.knoten.m_staudaemme.name: Dams and reservoirs
netz.knoten.m_wasserleitungen.name: Water mains and treatment plants
netz.knoten.m_wasserleitungen.text: Drinking water network, fewer leaks, wastewater treatment.
netz.knoten.m_saatgut.name: Seed and producer programmes
netz.knoten.m_mechanisierung.name: Farm mechanisation
netz.knoten.m_mechanisierung.text: Tractors, combine harvesters and harvesting machines: from manual work to machines to high tech with GPS and drones. Higher yields, fewer workers, diesel use and maintenance costs.
netz.knoten.m_agrarforschung.name: Agricultural research and high tech
netz.knoten.m_agrarforschung.text: High-yield seed, precision farming, soil sensors and digital farms.
netz.knoten.m_industrie_modernisierung.t: New generations of machinery and automation. The changeover takes time; old plants keep running, skilled workers are needed.
netz.knoten.m_verwaltungsdigital.name: Digital administration and tax technology
netz.knoten.m_verwaltungsdigital.text: E-invoicing, data matching, digital procedures: from paper files to connected processes.
netz.knoten.m_fachkraefteprogramm.name: Skilled workers and further training
netz.knoten.m_fachkraefteprogramm.text: Technical schools, master craftsmen, retraining: the ladder of progress needs people who can work it.
netz.knoten.m_bildungstechnik.name: Education technology and digital learning
netz.knoten.m_bildungstechnik.text: Devices, learning platforms and teacher training.
netz.knoten.m_medizintechnik.name: Medical technology and hospital modernisation
netz.knoten.m_medizintechnik.text: Digital diagnostics, modern equipment, connected patient records.
netz.knoten.m_smart_infrastruktur.name: Smart infrastructure
netz.knoten.m_smart_infrastruktur.text: Traffic management systems, sensors, digital networks: more capacity without new roads.
netz.knoten.m_speicher_smartgrid.name: Grid modernisation and storage
netz.knoten.m_speicher_smartgrid.text: Smart grid, battery storage, digital load management.
netz.knoten.m_bauindustrie.text: Modular and prefabricated building: factory-quality homes, faster and cheaper.
netz.knoten.m_polizeitechnik.text: Forensics, digital case files, better coordination between agencies.
netz.knoten.m_digitale_oeffentlichkeit.t: Online participation, open data, digital public services.
netz.knoten.m_handelssysteme.name: Modern customs and trade systems
netz.knoten.m_handelssysteme.text: Digital customs clearance, traceable supply chains, implementing trade agreements.
netz.knoten.p_wassermangel.text: Water supply is getting worse; some cities ration water.
netz.knoten.p_landflucht.text: Villages are emptying, schools and surgeries close.
netz.knoten.mieten.name: Rents
netz.knoten.mieten.text: Rents in the cities relative to income.
netz.knoten.wohnungsbau.name: Housing construction
netz.knoten.bauwirtschaft.name: Construction industry
netz.knoten.bauqualitaet.name: Building quality
netz.knoten.bauqualitaet.text: Whether buildings are built to code.
netz.knoten.erdbebenvorsorge.name: Earthquake preparedness
netz.knoten.erdbebenvorsorge.text: How many buildings are earthquake-proof and how well civil protection is prepared.
netz.knoten.katastrophenschutz.name: Disaster management (AFAD)
netz.knoten.katastrophenschutz.text: How well the agency, rescue services, depots and early warning are prepared for earthquakes, floods and fires (AFAD).
netz.knoten.m_sozialwohnungen.name: State housing construction
netz.knoten.m_sozialwohnungen.text: Homes built by the state housing agency, sold or let cheaply.
netz.knoten.m_stadterneuerung.name: Earthquake-proof urban renewal
netz.knoten.m_stadterneuerung.text: Demolition and rebuilding of unsafe houses.
netz.knoten.m_bauaufsicht.name: Building inspection
netz.knoten.m_bauaufsicht.text: Independent checks of structure and materials.
netz.knoten.m_baukredite.name: Cheap building loans
netz.knoten.m_bauamnestie.name: Building amnesty
netz.knoten.m_bauamnestie.text: Retroactive legalisation of illegal buildings for a fee.
netz.knoten.m_gebaeudeverstaerkung.name: Building reinforcement programme
netz.knoten.m_gebaeudeverstaerkung.text: Retrofitting thousands of unsafe old buildings: the most expensive and most effective precaution for the existing stock.
netz.knoten.m_versicherungspflicht.name: Compulsory disaster insurance
netz.knoten.m_versicherungspflicht.text: All buildings insured against earthquake and flood (DASK model); the state carries less of the liability.
netz.knoten.m_fruehwarnsystem.name: Early warning system
netz.knoten.m_fruehwarnsystem.text: Sensors and warnings seconds ahead of earthquakes and flash floods, straight to people's phones.
netz.knoten.m_afad_ausbau.name: Expanding the disaster agency (AFAD)
netz.knoten.m_afad_ausbau.text: Staff, supply depots and regional bases of the disaster agency.
netz.knoten.p_wohnungsnot.text: Rents eat up incomes, young families cannot find a home.
netz.knoten.p_erdbebengefahr.text: Many buildings would not survive a strong earthquake.
netz.knoten.kriminalitaet.name: Crime
netz.knoten.terrorgefahr.name: Terror threat
netz.knoten.justizvertrauen.name: Trust in the judiciary
netz.knoten.justizvertrauen.text: Whether people believe they will be treated fairly in court.
netz.knoten.korruption.name: Corruption
netz.knoten.rechtssicherheit.name: Legal certainty
netz.knoten.rechtssicherheit.text: Whether rules apply equally to everyone and are predictable.
netz.knoten.militaer.name: Readiness of the armed forces
netz.knoten.militaer.text: Equipment, training and morale of the army.
netz.knoten.m_polizei.text: Staffing and equipment of the security forces.
netz.knoten.m_justizreform.name: Judicial reform
netz.knoten.m_justizreform.text: Reform package for the court system: procedural law, training, court structure. Judicial posts and the judicial council are separate levers.
netz.knoten.m_antikorruption.name: Fighting corruption
netz.knoten.m_antikorruption.text: Independent investigators, open tenders, asset declarations.
netz.knoten.m_friedensprozess.name: Peace process
netz.knoten.m_friedensprozess.text: A political solution with disarmament and reintegration.
netz.knoten.m_verteidigung.name: Defence spending
netz.knoten.m_verteidigung.text: Budget for the armed forces and the defence industry.
netz.knoten.m_ruestungsindustrie.name: Domestic defence industry
netz.knoten.m_ruestungsindustrie.text: Drones, tanks and ships from domestic production.
netz.knoten.p_korruption.text: Contracts and offices are bought; the press reports on it.
netz.knoten.p_kriminalitaet.name: Insecurity on the streets
netz.knoten.p_kriminalitaet.text: People no longer feel safe at night.
netz.knoten.pressefreiheit.name: Press freedom
netz.knoten.polarisierung.name: Polarisation
netz.knoten.polarisierung.text: How deep the political divides are.
netz.knoten.vertrauen_regierung.name: Trust in the government
netz.knoten.religioesitaet.name: Religious character
netz.knoten.religioesitaet.text: How strongly religious values shape everyday life.
netz.knoten.frauenrechte.name: Gender equality
netz.knoten.frauenrechte.text: Women's rights and protection in everyday life.
netz.knoten.zivilgesellschaft.name: Civil society
netz.knoten.zivilgesellschaft.text: Associations, foundations and initiatives that get involved.
netz.knoten.m_medienaufsicht.name: Media regulation
netz.knoten.m_medienaufsicht.text: Fines and broadcast bans by the broadcasting regulator.
netz.knoten.m_internetsperren.name: Internet blocking
netz.knoten.m_internetsperren.text: Blocking of sites and posts, throttling of social media.
netz.knoten.m_staatsmedien.name: State media and advertising
netz.knoten.m_staatsmedien.text: Budget for state broadcasters and government advertising.
netz.knoten.m_religionsbehoerde.name: Budget of the religious affairs authority
netz.knoten.m_gewaltschutz.name: Protection from violence against women
netz.knoten.m_gewaltschutz.text: Women's shelters, protection orders, police training.
netz.knoten.m_versammlungsfreiheit.text: How freely demonstrations may take place.
netz.knoten.p_polarisierung.name: Deep division
netz.knoten.p_polarisierung.text: The camps no longer talk to each other.
netz.knoten.gefluechtete.name: Refugees in the country
netz.knoten.gefluechtete.text: Number of refugees, above all from Syria.
netz.knoten.beziehungen_eu.name: Relations with the EU
netz.knoten.beziehungen_usa.name: Relations with the USA
netz.knoten.beziehungen_russland.name: Relations with Russia
netz.knoten.beziehungen_nahost.name: Relations with the Middle East neighbours
netz.knoten.beziehungen_nahost.text: Syria, Iraq, Iran, Israel, Gulf states.
netz.knoten.ansehen.name: International standing
netz.knoten.ansehen.text: How the country is seen abroad.
netz.knoten.m_rueckkehr.name: Return programme for refugees
netz.knoten.m_rueckkehr.text: Incentives and agreements for return to Syria.
netz.knoten.m_integration.name: Integration of refugees
netz.knoten.m_integration.text: Language courses, work permits, school places.
netz.knoten.m_grenzschutz.text: Walls, staff and technology at the borders.
netz.knoten.m_eu_annaeherung.name: Rapprochement with the EU
netz.knoten.m_eu_annaeherung.text: Reforms for visa freedom and the customs union.
netz.knoten.p_migrationsdruck.text: Resentment against refugees, conflicts in neighbourhoods.
netz.knoten.rentner.name: Pensioners
netz.knoten.rentner.text: Live on pensions; feel inflation and the state of healthcare.
netz.knoten.arbeitnehmer.name: Workers
netz.knoten.arbeitnehmer.text: Employees and workers; care about wages, jobs and prices.
netz.knoten.unternehmer.name: Business owners and the self-employed
netz.knoten.unternehmer.text: Care about credit, taxes, costs and reliable rules.
netz.knoten.landwirte.name: Farmers
netz.knoten.landwirte.text: Care about yields, prices, water and subsidies.
netz.knoten.junge.name: Young adults
netz.knoten.junge.text: Care about jobs, housing, education and freedom.
netz.knoten.beamte.name: Public servants
netz.knoten.beamte.text: Care about salaries and the state of the state.
netz.knoten.konservative.name: Religious conservatives
netz.knoten.konservative.text: Care about values, family, stability and security.
netz.knoten.staedtische_saekulare.name: Secular city dwellers
netz.knoten.staedtische_saekulare.text: Care about freedom, the rule of law, education and the economy.
netz.knoten.justiz_unabhaengigkeit.name: Judicial independence
netz.knoten.justiz_unabhaengigkeit.text: Whether judges and prosecutors decide without instructions or pressure. The judicial council, appointed by the president and parliament, shapes it.
netz.knoten.justiz_kapazitaet.name: Court capacity
netz.knoten.justiz_kapazitaet.text: Judges, prosecutors and courtrooms relative to the caseload. Turkey has 17 judges per 100,000 inhabitants, the European average is 22.
netz.knoten.justiz_effizienz.name: Efficiency of proceedings
netz.knoten.justiz_effizienz.text: How quickly proceedings end. In 2024 criminal courts took 228 days on average, civil courts 231, enforcement 919.
netz.knoten.urteilsbefolgung.name: Compliance with rulings
netz.knoten.urteilsbefolgung.text: Whether authorities and courts implement rulings of the Constitutional Court and the Strasbourg court. The proceedings in the Kavala case have been running under Article 46 since 2022.
netz.knoten.haftueberfuellung.name: Prison overcrowding
netz.knoten.haftueberfuellung.text: In August 2026, 433,520 people were held in 304,956 places, about 142 per cent. A high value means more overcrowding.
netz.knoten.ausnahmerecht.name: Emergency law
netz.knoten.ausnahmerecht.text: How much state action runs through emergency powers and special rules. From 2016 to 2018 a state of emergency with 32 decrees was in force. A high value means more emergency law.
netz.knoten.anwaltsautonomie.name: Autonomy of the bar
netz.knoten.anwaltsautonomie.text: Whether the bar associations can speak freely and accompany proceedings. The 2020 law allows additional bars in big cities; all 80 bars rejected it.
netz.knoten.strassburg_druck.name: Pressure from Strasbourg
netz.knoten.strassburg_druck.text: Outstanding judgments and proceedings of the European Court of Human Rights that Ankara is to implement. A high value means more pressure.
netz.knoten.legitimitaet.name: Government legitimacy
netz.knoten.legitimitaet.text: How far citizens, officials and partners consider the rules of government lawful. It falls with emergency law and arbitrariness and rises with an independent judiciary, legal certainty and success.
netz.knoten.bereitschaft_heer.name: Army readiness
netz.knoten.bereitschaft_heer.text: How much of the army's equipment and personnel is actually ready, with training and spare parts.
netz.knoten.bereitschaft_luft.name: Air force readiness
netz.knoten.bereitschaft_luft.text: Aircraft and air defences ready for action, with pilots, technicians and spare parts.
netz.knoten.bereitschaft_see.name: Navy readiness
netz.knoten.bereitschaft_see.text: Ships and boats ready for action; the navy is growing with its own frigates and a helicopter carrier.
netz.knoten.modernisierung.name: Modernisation of equipment
netz.knoten.modernisierung.text: Share of the latest generation of systems: drones, fighter jets, tanks, air defence.
netz.knoten.ruestungsautarkie.name: Defence self-sufficiency
netz.knoten.ruestungsautarkie.text: How much the armed forces get from domestic industry. Engines and electronics remain gaps; own engines for the fighter jet and tank are still pending.
netz.knoten.truppenmoral.name: Troop morale
netz.knoten.truppenmoral.text: How willingly soldiers serve and how secure they feel about leadership and supplies.
netz.knoten.offiziersvertrauen.name: Trust in the officer corps
netz.knoten.offiziersvertrauen.text: Whether officers expect promotion on merit. After 2016, by estimates, 40 per cent to two thirds of generals were dismissed.
netz.knoten.abschreckung.name: Deterrence
netz.knoten.abschreckung.text: What neighbours and adversaries believe the armed forces can do: readiness, modernisation, alliance backing.
netz.knoten.kulturerbe.name: Preservation of cultural heritage
netz.knoten.kulturerbe.text: Condition of historic sites, towns and monuments; set per province from the state's building stock.
netz.knoten.identitaet.name: National identity and cohesion
netz.knoten.identitaet.text: How strongly people feel bound together by history, language and symbols.
netz.knoten.vielfalt.name: Acceptance of cultural and religious diversity
netz.knoten.vielfalt.text: How the majority and the authorities see minorities and faith communities: Alevis, Armenians, Greeks, Jews, Syrians, Kurds.
netz.knoten.wartungszustand.name: State of the facilities
netz.knoten.wartungszustand.text: How well roads, bridges, rails, pipes and power plants are maintained. More facilities need more maintenance.
netz.knoten.m_richterstellen.name: Posts for judges and prosecutors
netz.knoten.m_richterstellen.text: More posts, training places and courtrooms; takes years to work because training takes time.
netz.knoten.m_richterrat.name: Composition of the judicial council
netz.knoten.m_richterrat.text: Who chooses the members of the Council of Judges and Prosecutors (HSK), which decides on the appointment, transfer and promotion of judges.
netz.knoten.m_haftvermeidung.name: Alternatives to custody and probation
netz.knoten.m_haftvermeidung.text: Pre-trial detention only as a last resort, probation and electronic monitoring instead of prison.
netz.knoten.m_notstand.name: State of emergency and special powers
netz.knoten.m_notstand.text: How far the government acts with emergency powers and special rules instead of passing laws in the normal procedure.
netz.knoten.m_urteilsumsetzung.name: Implementing court rulings from Strasbourg and Ankara
netz.knoten.m_urteilsumsetzung.text: Whether authorities and courts implement rulings of the Constitutional Court and the European Court of Human Rights.
netz.knoten.m_denkmalschutz.name: Heritage protection and restoration
netz.knoten.m_denkmalschutz.text: Staff, funds and rules for preserving historic sites and old towns.
netz.knoten.m_kulturfoerderung.name: Arts and culture funding
netz.knoten.m_kulturfoerderung.text: Theatre, music, literature, film funding and festivals.
netz.knoten.m_archaeologie.name: Excavations and museums
netz.knoten.m_archaeologie.text: Excavation permits, restoration workshops, museums and night museums.
netz.knoten.m_minderheitenrechte.name: Rights of religious and linguistic minorities
netz.knoten.m_minderheitenrechte.text: Schools, languages, church and monastery property, Alevi places of worship.
netz.knoten.m_wehrdienst.name: Military service
netz.knoten.m_wehrdienst.text: Length and type of military service. Today six months, with exemption available for a fee.
netz.knoten.m_uebungen.name: Training and exercises
netz.knoten.m_uebungen.text: Manoeuvres, flying hours, days at sea and training places for pilots and technicians.
netz.knoten.m_offiziersauswahl.name: Promotion by the Supreme Military Council
netz.knoten.m_offiziersauswahl.text: The criteria by which the Supreme Military Council promotes and retires officers in August.
netz.knoten.m_instandhaltung.name: Infrastructure maintenance
netz.knoten.m_instandhaltung.text: Maintenance, renewal and refurbishment of roads, bridges, rails and pipes.
netz.knoten.minderheiten.name: Minorities
netz.knoten.minderheiten.text: Kurds, Alevis, Christians and others: care about rights, language, security and the situation of their regions.
netz.knoten.nationalisten.name: Nationalists and security-minded voters
netz.knoten.nationalisten.text: Care about the strength of the state, borders, security and the unity of the country.
netz.knoten.arme.name: People in poverty
netz.knoten.arme.text: Barely making ends meet: care about prices, social benefits, housing and work.
